## 3dslibris 3.1.0

This one is all about speed: the library opens faster, books load faster, and PDF, CBZ and illustrations now use the 3DS GPU for smooth zoom and pan.

It also adds library search and image rotation, and fixes the cut-off letters at larger font sizes.

### New

- [#167](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/167): search your library. Press `Y` or choose `search` in general settings to find books and folders by filename, or books by title or author.
- [#170](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/170): rotate illustrations in EPUB, MOBI and FB2 by 90° with `L` / `R` or two touch buttons. Zoom and position are kept.
- GPU zoom and pan for PDF, XPS, CBZ and illustrations, with automatic fallback to the old renderer if the GPU or memory isn't available. Works in Wide top-screen mode and in all three orientations.
- Progressive PDF zoom and pan: the zoomed page no longer blocks while it renders. It appears tile by tile, the overview is drawn after the page, and it also works in Wide top-screen mode. Panning at high zoom is about 80% faster on Old 3DS.
- `preload book data` in GENERAL settings: prepares covers and book info for the whole library in one go, so browsing is instant afterwards. It can be cancelled at any time.
- Opening an EPUB, MOBI or FB2 now shows clear progress, and you can cancel with `B` / `START`.

### Fixes and improvements

- [#172](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/172): fix the last letter of a word being cut off at larger font sizes (seen at 14), including spaces and non-Latin text such as Armenian, Arabic and CJK.
- [#139](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/139): the same text-measuring fix helps pages that ended early or lost words at the bottom.
- [#90](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/90): MOBI and FB2 books open faster and keep a saved page cache, like EPUB.
- Faster startup: about 50% less time before the library appears.
- Faster EPUB opening (about 30–40% less) and page turns (about 80% less in the tests I ran). Searching inside a book is also much quicker.
- Reading backwards in a book needs fewer SD card reads.
- Large covers, including high-resolution EPUB covers that were rejected before, now load.
- Covers load faster, and books without a cover (FB2) are no longer scanned again every time.
- Replacing a book with a different file now shows the new text instead of pages from the old one. Changing bold, italic, monospace or fallback fonts also rebuilds the pages correctly.
- Your reading position is kept more reliably when changing books, going to a page, or changing a setting that re-paginates. A failed open no longer leaves the previous book selected.
- Lower memory use with images, PDF and CBZ.
- Fix Old 3DS running out of memory and exiting to the Homebrew Launcher when opening very long EPUBs for the first time.
- Fix nested tables, long FB2 titles, library folder backgrounds, duplicated bookmarks and custom fonts being forgotten on startup.
- Deleting `README.md` or `QuickStart.txt` from your library now keeps them gone (hi YouTube).
- Many small speed-ups in book parsing and drawing.

### Updating

Reading progress, bookmarks and preferences are kept.

Page caches from earlier versions are rebuilt automatically the first time you open each book, so the first open takes as long as before. Pages may break slightly differently at larger font sizes. FB2 caches include the original images and can use more SD space.

This version needs libctru 2.7.1 or later to build. Latest Luma 13.5 is recommended for the best performance.

Measurements come from Azahar emulator comparisons and vary by book and device.

### Downloads

- `3dslibris.cia` or `3dslibris.3dsx` for normal use.
- `3dslibris-sdmc.zip`: runtime files for Homebrew Launcher installs; use with the `.3dsx` download.
- Debug builds (`3dslibris-debug.cia` / `3dslibris-debug.3dsx`) and `3dslibris-source.tar.gz` are also included.

Thanks to everyone trying the builds and reporting issues. You can support the project with a ⭐ on GitHub or [a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rigle).
